lines.en: : Ahh! Boy am I glad to be out of that stuffy maid outfit. Looking cute sure can be exhausting sometimes.
: Ami, I don’t think I’m supposed to be in here.
: You can be wherever I want you to be! Plus, it’s not like you wandered in on your own. I dragged you in myself, which I am allowed to do since I work here!
: It’s the exact type of situation we were shooting for when you decided I was allowed to work at the maid cafe!
: I decided you were allowed to work at the maid cafe so you could make more money. Not so you could strip down to your underwear in a locker room while everyone else is clothed and working.
: Huh. Guess I’m just misremembering then.
As you can see, Ami is mostly naked. Which means I am mostly in danger.
But it’s not just because the only thing that gets her blood pumping is blood of a similar type and that she could very well attack me at any given moment-
It’s because, as I just mentioned to her, we are not alone.
Unfortunately, her head is so empty that anything apart from compliments or words of affirmation goes in one ear, out the other, and then ultimately falls to its death on the floor.
But hey, on the bright side, she really does seem to be on at least...mostly good behavior today. And it’s not like she’s putting on an act about the whole “stuffy costume” thing.
I’ve never dressed in a maid outfit before, nor do I intend to, but just being in these clothes in this weather is enough to make me start questioning my decision to go out today.
Damn the sun and damn my love for maids.
: You know, even if we don’t see eye to eye on why you let me get a job here, I’ve gotta say that life has gotten pretty interesting ever since then-
: Which is super great since being stuck inside of that house all the time was starting to get really boring.
: I want to stop you for a second there and just throw out the fact that you can’t just say we don’t see eye to eye on my reasons for doing things. Only I know what I think.
: But what if I have super awesome mind-reading powers like Anya Forger and just never told you about them?
: That would certainly explain a lot of things, for sure. But I know it can’t be true based on the fact that you haven’t stabbed any of your classmates yet.
: Stabbed?! Why would I stab any of them?! Do I really look like the stabbing type to you? With these scrawny arms? You know me better than that.
: I know you very well. Which means I also know how...protective you are over me.
: And by “protective” I mean terrifyingly attached to the point where it is almost intimidating.
: And by “almost” I mean it can be very intimidating.
: I mean...sure. I get it. But that still doesn’t mean I’d hurt anybody. Ayane’s been in love with you forever and I haven’t stabbed her yet.
: Good. Continue not doing that for the rest of forever and we won’t have a problem.
: Hey, is something going on? You seem a little weird today.
: As the only one fully clothed in this room, I beg to differ.
: Technically, it isn’t weird to be undressed in a locker room. So you can go ahead and get naked too if that makes you feel better, Sensei. It’s only natural.
: I’m good. It’s risky enough being in here like this...and I doubt I’d be able to talk myself out of anyone walking in if I wasn’t wearing anything.
: So don’t talk your way out of it! No harm in Uta-chan or Osako-chan knowing how much you love your niece.
: There is when the way I love you transcends the way I’m supposed to.
: Nuh-uh. You love me exactly how you’re supposed to. And anyone who has a problem with that just doesn’t understand.
: To be honest, if you didn’t love me the right way after all this time, I’d probably go insane! So be happy that you do!
: Wow, awesome. That’s so reassuring. Thanks, Ami.
: You could always grow a backbone and just have sex with me already. Then you wouldn’t have anything to hide at all.
: Please don’t do that.
: Do what? Remind you that I want you to fuck my tight, virgin pussy while I wrap my legs around your waist and dig my nails into your back? Doesn’t that sound hot?
: Just you and me...and whoever else decides to walk in. But of course, they’d be forced to watch since you’d never even think about giving any of our DNA to somebody else, right?
: You need to stop.
: No.
: Ami-
: Why would I stop? I’m in the midst of puberty and have so many feelings I need help understanding. If only there was someone who could help me learn.
: Preferably someone who’s familiar with my body so I know I’d be in good hands. And is also related to me and has glasses and is named Sensei.
: Basically, you should fuck me or I am going to go crazy. Like, for real.
: Like...for real.
: Like, for real.
: I’m going fucking insane.
: Anyway, regardless of how risky you think this is, I don’t see it as a bad idea at all.
: Yeah, of course you don’t. I’m 99%% sure the only reason you became a maid in the first place was because you knew I had a thing for them.
: Sounds pretty considerate if I do say so myself. Which I do because I am very considerate and am always putting your needs ahead of mine.
: This really was a nice change, though.
: I didn’t realize just how much I’d enjoy it until I started working here.
: Now, I don’t know if I’ll ever be able to stop.
: I might just stay a maid for the rest of eternity.
: Do you think I could live like that, Sensei?
: I think you might reach a point age-wise where it isn’t really feasible anymore. But hey, follow your dreams and all that.
: And if you’re lucky, you might even grow into a new uniform one day.
: Now, that was just plain rude.
: And in here you’ll find-
: Something that is...totally not safe for work...
: Uhh...
: Oh, hey! Don’t mind me. It was just a little too hot in the uniform, so I decided to take it off for my break since Sensei was cool with it. Right, Sensei?
: I had nothing to do with this.
: See? This is totally normal for him. It doesn’t even register as inappropriate.
: Anyway, did you guys need something? Because you’re kind of interrupting our conversation right now.
: Uhh...Uta was giving me a tour of the place since I’ve been thinking about coming to work here.
: You probably shouldn’t bother. It’s a lot of really hard work and we have enough employees already.
: Yeah, I can decide for myself...but thanks for the heads up.
: So, uhh...this probably wasn’t the most normal thing to walk into, but I swear that nothing like this has ever happened before and, if it has, I totally don’t know about it.
: It’s whatever. I’m not even surprised given that she drags him into dressing rooms with her as well. Besides, it’s not like Sensei thinks anything of it. Just look at him.
: I don’t know, Chika. It might not be official, but Ami’s held the number one spot in the Sensei love ranking ever since it was established.
: Wait, Ami is number one?! And I’m only in the top five?! Are you fucking kidding me?!
: I...I see you’re already familiar with the ranking! That’s good!
: How much did she pay you for that spot?! I’ll pay double!
: Chika, you’re poor. And also shouldn’t be fighting for this right now.
: Oh. Uh...yeah. I mean, it’s just a stupid ranking after all. I don’t even need to be on it or whatever. Plus, it’s, like...not even official.
: R...Right!
: So, umm...anyway, this is the locker room. And when Ami isn’t busy trying to get weird with her uncle, it’s where we stash our stuff and change into our uniforms and whatnot.
: If you do decide that this might be the place for you, you’ll get a locker along the wall and-
: And that’s it! Locker room tour over! Bye, guys! Sensei and I were talking about important family business and, I don’t want to be rude, but you’re kind of still in the way.
: Oh. Sorry, Ami. I’m used to important family conversations being held with clothes on. I didn’t realize it was different for other families.
: That’s fine. I understand. Bye.
: Huh. My family didn’t have many talks like that, but I’m pretty sure we would’ve kept our clothes on too. But hey, different strokes for different folks, I guess.
: Ugh, whatever. Let’s just go.
: Wait! Don’t you want to try on the uniform first?! I have an extra! And if it sounds like I’m excited to see you in it, it’s probably just because I really like maids!
: That would be a bad idea since Sensei is in here and it would be like, totally weird for a teenager he’s not related to to get undressed in front of him.
: Right, yeah. And it’s not weird at all for his niece to do that.
: Exactly.
: Do you seriously just not understand sarcasm at all?
: Guess not. See you in school, Chika!
: Whatever. Come on, Uta.
: Wait! Noooooo!
: The nerve of some people. Not realizing when they should both knock and mind their own business. We’re clearly in the middle of something here.
: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
: There was no reason for you to act that way toward them, Ami.
: It would be one thing for Uta since the two of you see each other all the time and she can just laugh it off...But Chika doesn’t know you that well. And you don’t want her to be your enemy.
: Why would she be my enemy? All I did was ask for some alone time with my uncle. If she takes that the wrong way, that’s on her.
: This might be the locker room, but it’s also the break room. And I’m on break right now, which means I shouldn’t have to worry about work-related stuff.
: You just could have been a little nicer. That’s all I’m saying.
: Mm...you’re right. Maybe I was a little too pushy just now?...
: I should probably go and apologize...
: You should probably get dressed first. Because as happy as the customers might be to see a maid in her underwear, I can’t imagine your coworkers would feel the same.
: I can’t imagine I’d have any coworkers after pulling a stunt like that.
: I’ll just apologize whenever I see Chika next. I don’t have anything against her. In fact, I kinda look up to her in a bunch of ways.
: She’s gorgeous...and cool...and popular...and can pull off, like...any outfit ever. Plus, she’s smart and has really nice boobs that I am only kind of jealous of.
: And by “kind of” I mean I want her boobs.
: Or any boobs.
: But alas...Ami is a washboard...
: I’m not going to weigh in on the whole apologizing thing since this doesn’t really have to do with me, but I’m glad to hear you’re considering it.
: Of course. I’m one of the good guys.
: But you’re wrong about this not having anything to do with you.
: I thought it was pretty clear Chika was jealous back there. And that’s probably why I acted the way I did. I doubt I would have snapped if it was someone who didn’t like the same person as me.
: Have you ever considered maybe...not caring about how other girls feel about me? People can’t help who they fall for. You shouldn’t resent them for that.
: I don’t resent anybody. Like I said, I admire Chika.
: I just get a little irked when I think about the two of you together and go into protective mode. But it’s not like that’s a new thing.
: I just want you to be safe. That’s all.
: And you don’t think I’d be safe with Chika?
: Right.
: Why?
: Because she’s a teenager.
: And you’re not?
: I’m different. I’m your niece. We live together. If you lived with Chika, it would raise some eyebrows.
: So when Chika graduates high school-
: Actually, when all of the girls graduate high school, you’ll be okay with me dating them?
: Hmm...
: Are you actually thinking about it?
: Of course. You asked me a serious question, so it’s my responsibility to give you a serious answer.
: And that serious answer is no.
: I won’t ever be okay with you dating anyone other than me because I am the one you love the most and we are meant to be together. The end.
: You almost got me, though.
: I wasn’t trying to get you, Ami. I was trying to help you understand that I can be safe with other people. It doesn’t have to be you.
: What are you talking about? Of course it does.
: No, it doesn’t. And to be honest, you’ve been getting way too clingy lately. Which is crazy since you were already clingy to start with.
: I’m serious. You need to start letting me breathe.
: I love you. But my world doesn’t revolve around you.
: Yes it does...
: I do everything for you. You’d...be nowhere without me.
: You’d have no clean clothes and live off of instant noodles. The trash would pile up and the house would start smelling weird.
: You’d have to warm the bath all by yourself and you always complain when you have to do that. And that’s not even counting all of the times you’ve asked for help with-
: How can I get better at anything if you’re always just...going to do everything for me?
: ...What?
: Why would you need to get better?
: Who told you that you need to get better?
: No one.
: I just...do.
: But...no.
: No.
: You’re already...the best you can be.
: You don’t need to grow any more.
: You’ve done enough.
: I haven’t.
: And I’d appreciate it if you’d stop suffocating me.
: No.
Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
